questions.q: A 16-year-old female with Anorexia Nervosa is being re-fed. The medical team is monitoring for 'Refeeding Syndrome.' Which electrolyte imbalance is the hallmark warning sign of this condition?
questions.explain: Refeeding syndrome is characterized by a dangerous drop in electrolytes (especially Phosphorus, also Potassium and Magnesium) as cells rapidly take up nutrients after starvation. Hypophosphatemia can lead to cardiac failure.
